python -c "
import glom
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT, Invoke
from glom import Assign, assign

print('=== R2: Public API ===')
for name in ['Auto', 'Fill', 'Iter', 'Let', 'ROOT', 'Invoke']:
    assert hasattr(glom, name), f'{name} not found in glom'
    print(f'  {name}: OK')

print()
print('=== R3: Invoke and constants ===')
print(f'  Invoke class: {Invoke}')
from glom import constants
print(f'  constants.SKIP: {constants.SKIP}')
print(f'  constants.STOP: {constants.STOP}')
print(f'  constants.OMIT: {constants.OMIT}')
print(f'  constants.ROOT: {constants.ROOT}')

print()
print('=== R4: Fill repr ===')
f = Fill('missing', 'default')
print(f'  Fill repr: {repr(f)}')

print()
print('=== R5: Assign repr ===')
a = Assign('a.b', 'value')
print(f'  Assign repr: {repr(a)}')
af = assign('x.y', 123)
print(f'  assign repr: {repr(af)}')

print()
print('=== R6: Coalesce repr ===')
from glom import Coalesce
c = Coalesce('a', 'b')
print(f'  Coalesce repr: {repr(c)}')

print()
print('=== R7: Other specifiers repr ===')
auto = Auto()
print(f'  Auto repr: {repr(auto)}')
check = Check(type(int))
print(f'  Check repr: {repr(check)}')

print()
print('All tests passed!')
"
